question_vi: Blue/Green deployment và Canary deployment trên AWS là gì? Giải thích cách implement từng strategy.
question_en: What are Blue/Green and Canary deployments on AWS? Explain how to implement each strategy.
answer_vi:
Blue/Green deployment: duy trì hai environment giống nhau (Blue = production hiện tại, Green = version mới); deploy và test Green hoàn toàn, sau đó switch traffic 100% từ Blue sang Green (thường qua Route 53 DNS swap hoặc ALB listener rule update); rollback instant bằng switch lại Blue; Blue environment giữ lại một thời gian rồi mới terminate.

Implement Blue/Green trên AWS: (1) EC2 + ALB: tạo Target Group mới cho Green, register instances mới, test qua staging URL, update ALB listener rule để point sang Green TG; (2) ECS: CodeDeploy blue/green cho ECS — tự động tạo task set mới, shift traffic theo schedule, rollback nếu alarm trigger; (3) Lambda: Lambda aliases với CodeDeploy, shift traffic theo Linear/Canary/AllAtOnce deployment config.

Canary deployment là biến thể của blue/green: thay vì switch 100% ngay, shift dần một tỷ lệ nhỏ traffic sang version mới (5%, 10%, 25%, 50%, 100%) trong khoảng thời gian, monitor metrics/errors ở mỗi bước; nếu metric xấu thì rollback, nếu OK thì tiếp tục tăng. API Gateway có built-in canary release — shift % traffic sang new stage. Route 53 Weighted routing cho canary ở DNS level. CloudWatch alarms trigger automatic rollback khi error rate vượt threshold.

Canary an toàn hơn cho big changes, blue/green nhanh hơn khi confident với version mới
answer_en:
Blue/Green deployment: maintain two identical environments (Blue = current production, Green = new version); fully deploy and test Green, then switch 100% of traffic from Blue to Green (typically via Route 53 DNS swap or ALB listener rule update); rollback instantly by switching back to Blue; the Blue environment is kept for a period before being terminated.

Implementing Blue/Green on AWS: (1) EC2 + ALB: create a new Target Group for Green, register new instances, test via a staging URL, then update the ALB listener rule to point to the Green TG; (2) ECS: CodeDeploy blue/green for ECS — automatically creates a new task set, shifts traffic on a schedule, and rolls back if an alarm triggers; (3) Lambda: use Lambda aliases with CodeDeploy and Linear/Canary/AllAtOnce deployment configs to shift traffic.

Canary deployment is a variant of blue/green: instead of switching 100% immediately, gradually shift a small percentage of traffic to the new version (5%, 10%, 25%, 50%, 100%) over time, monitoring metrics and errors at each step — roll back if metrics degrade, continue if they look good. API Gateway has built-in canary release — shift a percentage of traffic to a new stage. Route 53 Weighted routing enables canary at the DNS level. CloudWatch alarms trigger automatic rollbacks when error rates exceed thresholds.

Canary is safer for major changes; blue/green is faster when you are confident in the new version
